```{r load}
  readxl::read_xlsx(paste0(here(),

                  "/PFS_OS_CaseReview_20260210.xlsx"))
medication_data <-
  read_rds(paste0(here(),

gyn_data <- gyn_data %>% 
  select(-c(germline_wes, tumor_wes, disease_type,
            number_of_blood_variants, number_of_tumor_variants,
            germline_kit, wes_batch, site,
            age_at_clinical_record_creation, year_of_clinical_record_creation)) %>% 
  mutate(had_prior_radiation = case_when(
    age_at_first_radiation > ever_first_rad_age       ~ "Yes"
  ))
```

```{r update PFS}
gyn_data <- pfs_data %>% 
  rename(pfs_time_from_treatment_years_updated = pfs_time_from_treatment_years,
         pfs_event_updated = pfs_event,
         pfs_age_updated = pfs_age) %>% 
  left_join(gyn_data, ., by = "avatar_key") %>% 
  # Recalculate time
  mutate(pfs_time_from_treatment_years_updated = pfs_age_updated - age_at_first_treatment) %>% 
  mutate(pfs_time_from_dx_years_updated = pfs_age_updated - age_at_diagnosis) %>% 
  # Use updated time then original time if NA
  mutate(pfs_age = coalesce(pfs_age_updated, pfs_age),
         pfs_time_from_treatment_years = coalesce(pfs_time_from_treatment_years_updated, pfs_time_from_treatment_years),
         pfs_time_from_dx_years = coalesce(pfs_time_from_dx_years_updated, pfs_time_from_dx_years)) %>% 
  # Remove time for patients that need to be excluded from survival analysis
  mutate_at(c("pfs_event", "pfs_age",
              "pfs_time_from_dx_years",
              "pfs_time_from_treatment_years"), ~ case_when(
                exclusion_pfs == "exclude"                     ~ NA_real_,
                TRUE                                           ~ .
              )) %>% 
  mutate_at(c("os_event", "os_age", 
              "os_time_from_dx_years",
              "os_time_from_treatment_years"), ~ case_when(
                reason_exclusion_pfs == "older than 90"        ~ NA_real_,
                TRUE                                           ~ .
              )) %>% 
  select(-c(pfs_time_from_treatment_years_updated, 
            pfs_event_updated,
            pfs_age_updated))
```
<br>

Note: we talked about censoring at 5 years
We started with `r nrow(gyn_data)` patients who has germline and tumor samples collected in "GYN - Ovarian Cancer" disease type.

# Patient characteristics
I asked Kavita, to code stage they take the maximun values from ClinGroupStage and GradePathological. 
No FIGO stage listed anywhere.   
BMI is selected to be the closest to Dx (before or after).
But in case of ovarian cancer for which patient often receive surgery, should I take only BMI before Dx.
Or make a rule depending if patient received surgery?
```{r}
gyn_data %>%
  select(age_at_diagnosis,
         not_real_age, #not_real_sequencing_age,
         race, ethnicity,
         raceeth,
         histotype, grade,
         hgsoc_vs_others, stage_cat, stage,
         # ecog, karnofsky,
         bmi, bmi_cat,
         smoking_status,
         first_treatment,
         time_dx_to_first_treatment_days,
         vital_status,
         os_event, os_time_from_treatment_years,
         pfs_event, pfs_time_from_treatment_years,
         ch_status, tumor_ch_status
         ) %>%
  tbl_summary(by = ch_status,
              type = list(all_dichotomous() ~ "categorical")#,
              # sort = list(all_categorical() ~ "frequency")
              ) %>%
  bold_labels() %>%
  add_p() %>% bold_p(t=0.05) %>% add_overall() %>%
  # add_stat_label() %>%
  modify_header(label ~ "**Patient characteristics**",
                all_stat_cols() ~ "**{level}**, N = {n}")
```
Patient with Unknown OS is a patient with a dx > 90 years old and follow up > 90 years old. We decided to exclude the patient from the survival analysis.   
2 patients missing first treatment only had surgery for a diagnosis not "Ovary". I looked at the data, I don't think we can salvage.

### Medications before germline
### For actual ovary dx
```{r}
gyn_data %>% 
  left_join(., medication_data, by = c("avatar_key" = "AvatarKey")) %>% 
  filter((AgeAtMedStart < germline_collection_age)) %>% 
  filter((MedPrimaryDiagnosisSite == primary_diagnosis_site) | 
           number_of_dx == 1) %>% 
  select(Medication) %>% 
  tbl_summary(sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) %>%
  bold_labels()
```

### For other diagnosis
```{r}
gyn_data %>% 
  left_join(., medication_data, by = c("avatar_key" = "AvatarKey")) %>% 
  filter(AgeAtMedStart < germline_collection_age) %>%
```

# Survival

For PFS I have "Progression" and "Recurrence", both are coded as event = 1.
For PFS event == 1, I use AgeAtProgRecur, and for pfs event == 0, I use AgeAtCurrentDiseaseStatus which is more accurate.
Patients who don't have info for PFS but have info for OS are not included into PFS coding as we are not sure if the patient had been seen/had a progression before their date of death/date of last contact.

```{r}
tbl1 <- tbl_uvregression(
  gyn_data,
  method = coxph,
  y = Surv(time = os_time_from_treatment_years, event = os_event),
  exponentiate = TRUE,
  include = c("ch_status", "germline_collection_age", 
              "hgsoc_vs_others", "histotype",
              "stage_cat", "bmi_cat"),
  pvalue_fun = label_style_pvalue(digits = 2)
  ) %>%
  bold_p(t = .05) %>%
  add_nevent(location = "level") %>% add_n(location = "level") %>%
  bold_labels() %>% italicize_levels() %>%
  modify_spanning_header(everything() ~ "**OS**")

tbl2 <- coxph(Surv(time = gyn_data$os_time_from_treatment_years,
                   event = gyn_data$os_event) ~ ch_status + germline_collection_age + 
        hgsoc_vs_others + stage_cat,
              data = gyn_data)  %>%
  tbl_regression(exponentiate = TRUE) %>%
  bold_p(t = .05) %>%
  add_nevent(location = "level") %>% add_n(location = "level") %>%
  modify_spanning_header(everything() ~ "**OS**")

# tbl3 <- coxph(Surv(time = gyn_data$os_time_from_treatment_years,
#                    event = gyn_data$os_event) ~ ch_status + germline_collection_age + 
#         grade + bmi_cat,
#               data = gyn_data)  %>%
#   tbl_regression(exponentiate = TRUE) %>%
#   bold_p(t = .05) %>%
#   add_nevent(location = "level") %>% add_n(location = "level") %>%
#   modify_spanning_header(everything() ~ "**OS**")

tbl_merge(list(tbl1, tbl2), tab_spanner = c("**Univariable**", "**Multivariable**"))
```

```{r}
ggsurvplot(survfit(Surv(os_time_from_treatment_years, os_event) ~ ch_status,
                   data = gyn_data),
           # title = "PFS Analysis",
           font.main = c(20, "bold", "black"),
           font.x = c(15, "bold", "black"),
           font.y = c(15, "bold", "black"),
           font.legend = c(14, "black"),
           font.tickslab = c(12, "bold", "black"),
           size = 1.5,

           xlab = "Time (years)",
           ylab = "OS (probability)",
           legend = "top",
           # legend.title = "",
           pval = TRUE,
           conf.int = FALSE,
           # Censor
           censor = TRUE
) %++% guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 1))
```

## Patient characteristics
```{r}
gyn_data %>% 
  select(age_at_diagnosis,
         # not_real_age, #not_real_sequencing_age,
         race, ethnicity,
         raceeth,
         histotype, grade,
         hgsoc_vs_others, stage_cat, stage,
         # ecog, karnofsky,
         bmi, bmi_cat,
         smoking_status,
         first_treatment,
         time_dx_to_first_treatment_days,
         vital_status,
         os_event, os_time_from_treatment_years,
         pfs_event, pfs_time_from_treatment_years,
         ch_status, tumor_ch_status
  ) %>%
  tbl_summary(by = ch_status,
              type = list(all_dichotomous() ~ "categorical")#,
              # sort = list(all_categorical() ~ "frequency")
              ) %>%
  bold_labels() %>%
  add_p() %>% bold_p(t=0.05) %>% add_overall() %>%
  # add_stat_label() %>%
  modify_header(label ~ "**Patient characteristics**",
                all_stat_cols() ~ "**{level}**, N = {n}")
```

## Survival

```{r}
gyn_data %>%
  select(has_os_data,
         vital_status,
         
         os_event, os_time_from_treatment_years,
         has_outcomes_data,
         pfs_event, pfs_time_from_treatment_years,
         ch_status, tumor_ch_status
         ) %>%
  tbl_summary(by = ch_status,
              type = list(all_dichotomous() ~ "categorical")) %>%
  bold_labels() %>%
  add_p() %>% bold_p(t = 0.05) %>% add_overall() %>%
  modify_header(label ~ "**Survival**")
```

### OS
```{r}
tbl1 <- tbl_uvregression(
  gyn_data,
  method = coxph,
  y = Surv(time = os_time_from_treatment_years, event = os_event),
  exponentiate = TRUE,
  include = c("ch_status", "germline_collection_age", 
              "histotype",
              "stage_cat", "bmi_cat"),
  pvalue_fun = label_style_pvalue(digits = 2)
  ) %>%
  bold_p(t = .05) %>%
  add_nevent(location = "level") %>% add_n(location = "level") %>%
  bold_labels() %>% italicize_levels() %>%
  modify_spanning_header(everything() ~ "**OS**")

tbl2 <- coxph(Surv(time = gyn_data$os_time_from_treatment_years,
                   event = gyn_data$os_event) ~ ch_status + germline_collection_age + 
        stage_cat,
              data = gyn_data)  %>%
  tbl_regression(exponentiate = TRUE) %>%
  bold_p(t = .05) %>%
  add_nevent(location = "level") %>% add_n(location = "level") %>%
  modify_spanning_header(everything() ~ "**OS**")

tbl_merge(list(tbl1, tbl2), tab_spanner = c("**Univariable**", "**Multivariable**"))
```

```{r}
ggsurvplot(survfit(Surv(os_time_from_treatment_years, os_event) ~ ch_status,
                   data = gyn_data),
           # title = "PFS Analysis",
           font.main = c(20, "bold", "black"),
           font.x = c(15, "bold", "black"),
           font.y = c(15, "bold", "black"),
           font.legend = c(14, "black"),
           font.tickslab = c(12, "bold", "black"),
           size = 1.5,

           xlab = "Time (years)",
           ylab = "OS (probability)",
           legend = "top",
           # legend.title = "",
           pval = TRUE,
           conf.int = FALSE,
           # Censor
           censor = TRUE
) %++% guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 1))
```
